title: Slovakia Caught Between Stubborn Inflation and Rising Security Fears · 18 Sep
keywords: Slovakia, inflation, GDP growth, economic slowdown, HICP, European Central Bank, fiscal consolidation, hybrid threats, drone factory, arson, sabotage, Central Europe, EU economy, Slovak government, security
notes: Slovakia's economy is growing at a pace too slow to ease household pain, while inflation remains above European Central Bank targets and sticky enough to erode purchasing power. At the same time, an alleged arson plot linked to a domestic drone factory has sharpened public anxiety about hybrid threats and foreign interference. Together, the two developments paint a picture of a country navigating economic fatigue and security unease simultaneously.
